records.context: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on application view* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These application views stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual application view-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own independent execution path* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the main GUI execution path's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a workflow is executing.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#16
records.source: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on screen* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These screens stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual screen-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own thread* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the GUI thread's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a pipeline is running.
records.translation: 1. *Tímamælirinn stöðvast þegar græjan sést ekki á skjánum* — falin, á öðrum flipa eða í lágmörkuðum glugga. Engir rammar, engin CPU-vinna. Þessir skjáir eru opnir klukkustundum saman, svo þetta skiptir mestu máli. 2. *Dreifð þemu eru teiknuð í litla endurnýtanlega QImage og stækkuð*. Lengri brún biðminnisins er það sem þemað skilgreinir (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) sinnum upplausnarstilling notandans, svo dreifðir fletir skyggja um ~37 000 pixla í stað ~2 000 000. Norðurljósa- og gagnalistaefnin varðveita upprunaleg smáatriði skjásins innan raunverulegra pixlafjöldamarka hans. Aurora skilar ramma í eigin eignarhaldi og kemur þannig í veg fyrir annað afrit í fullri stærð þegar skyggingarvinnuþráður birtir hann. 3. *Skyggingin fer fram á eigin þræði* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), svo allur hlutur GUI-þráðarins í rammanum er eitt ``drawImage``. Næsti kafli fjallar um þetta, sem skiptir máli meðan vinnslukeðja keyrir.

records.context: In that historical ``blobs`` benchmark, the rate goes from 17.3 fps to 24.7 on the same worker. What this does **not** address is a genuinely chatty run: at 200 lines a second both land at about 4 fps, because by then the main GUI execution path is inside ``ConsolePanel`` and not in here at all. Two levers finish the job and neither is in this file — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` in the Qt bootstrap (measured independently: 32 % of the frame rate to 99 %, for about 6 % of the worker's throughput) and coalescing ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.

records.source: In that historical ``blobs`` benchmark, the rate goes from 17.3 fps to 24.7 on the same worker. What this does **not** address is a genuinely chatty run: at 200 lines a second both land at about 4 fps, because by then the GUI thread is inside ``ConsolePanel`` and not in here at all. Two levers finish the job and neither is in this file — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` in the Qt bootstrap (measured independently: 32 % of the frame rate to 99 %, for about 6 % of the worker's throughput) and coalescing ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.
records.translation: Í þessari sögulegu ``blobs`` mælingu hækkar tíðnin úr 17.3 fps í 24.7 með sama vinnuþræði. Þetta leysir **ekki** keyrslu sem skrifar mjög mikið: við 200 línur á sekúndu enda báðar leiðir við um 4 fps, því þá er GUI-þráðurinn inni í ``ConsolePanel`` en alls ekki hér. Tvær aðgerðir ljúka verkinu og hvorug er í þessari skrá — ``sys.setswitchinterval(0.001)`` við ræsingu Qt (mælt sjálfstætt: úr 32 % rammatíðninnar í 99 %, fyrir um 6 % afköstum vinnuþráðarins) og sameining merkja frá ``PipelineWorker.line_ready``.

records.context: Performance depends on hardware, display size, theme, and concurrent work. Density controls population independently of Detail. Detail controls sampling resolution, and buffers stay within the actual screen-pixel budget. Increasing Detail does not trim the selected population. Legacy direct engine callers may still set blur, but Preferences exposes no Blur control. Hidden widgets stop rendering entirely. Historical timings above do not establish native 24 FPS at current maximum controls.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#58
records.source: Performance depends on hardware, display size, theme, and concurrent work. Density controls population independently of Detail. Detail controls sampling resolution, and buffers stay within the actual screen-pixel budget. Increasing Detail does not trim the selected population. Legacy direct engine callers may still set blur, but Preferences exposes no Blur control. Hidden widgets stop rendering entirely. Historical timings above do not establish native 24 FPS at current maximum controls.
records.translation: Afköst ráðast af vélbúnaði, skjástærð, þema og samhliða vinnu. Density stýrir fjölda eininga óháð Detail. Detail stýrir sýnatökuupplausn og biðminni haldast innan raunverulegra pixlafjöldamarka skjásins. Aukið Detail fækkar ekki völdum einingum. Eldri beinir notendur hreyfimótoranna geta enn stillt óskýrleika, en Preferences býður ekkert Blur-stjórntæki. Faldar græjur hætta alveg að teikna. Sögulegu tímamælingarnar hér að ofan staðfesta ekki 24 FPS við upprunalega skjáupplausn og núverandi hámarksstillingar.

records.context: The private growth producer uses ``_lineage`` to index reproducible wandering tips and recursive front forks. records.context: The field's background-only left drag uses ``_set_field_grab`` and ``_step_field_grab`` for a bounded local spring with continuous release velocity. ``AmbientWidget._offer_field_grab`` publishes the latest handle without waiting for shading, and ``AmbientWidget._field_grab_background`` excludes scientific canvases and interactive controls. Release returns the patch without moving or reseeding its underlying material.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#60
records.source: The field's background-only left drag uses ``_set_field_grab`` and ``_step_field_grab`` for a bounded local spring with continuous release velocity. ``AmbientWidget._offer_field_grab`` publishes the latest handle without waiting for shading, and ``AmbientWidget._field_grab_background`` excludes scientific canvases and interactive controls. Release returns the patch without moving or reseeding its underlying material.
records.translation: Vinstri dráttur á bakgrunni sviðsins einum notar ``_set_field_grab`` og ``_step_field_grab`` fyrir staðbundinn gorm með takmörkuðu áhrifasviði og samfelldum hraða við sleppingu. ``AmbientWidget._offer_field_grab`` birtir nýjasta handfangið án þess að bíða eftir skyggingu og ``AmbientWidget._field_grab_background`` útilokar vísindalega teiknifleti og gagnvirk stjórntæki. Við sleppingu snýr búturinn aftur án þess að færa eða endurmynda efnið undir honum.

records.context: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine#1
records.source: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.translation: Geislar rísa frá óreglulegum samanbrotnum neðri jaðri, breiðast mjúklega til himins og sveiflast á mismunandi hraða. Dreifður flötur tengir geislana án flatrar rétthyrndrar efri brúnar eða endurtekinna áferðarflísa. Raster ramammans notar upprunalega skjáupplausn við venjulegt Detail, innan raunverulegra pixlafjöldamarka skjásins, og er skilað með sjálfstæðu eignarhaldi. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` er áfram eldri samanburðarbrúnin; hún takmarkar ekki lengur virka biðminnið.

records.context: :meth:`geometry` yields ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` per sampled column of every curtain, in pixels, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` of them per curtain in curtain order. The painter builds its paths from exactly those numbers, so a test that tracks a fold crest through ``geometry`` is tracking the crest that is on application view. ``brightness`` is the travelling surge. Seeded irregular ray positions and independent continuous length and brightness cycles modulate the sampled sheet, with tapered tops. Roll the aurora's bands and their drift.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine#2
records.source: :meth:`geometry` yields ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` per sampled column of every curtain, in pixels, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` of them per curtain in curtain order. The painter builds its paths from exactly those numbers, so a test that tracks a fold crest through ``geometry`` is tracking the crest that is on screen. ``brightness`` is the travelling surge. Seeded irregular ray positions and independent continuous length and brightness cycles modulate the sampled sheet, with tapered tops. Roll the aurora's bands and their drift.
records.translation: :meth:`geometry` skilar ``(x, y_bottom, visible_height, brightness)`` fyrir hvern sýnatökudálk hvers ljósatjalds, í pixlum, ``AURORA_COLUMNS + 1`` slíkum á hvert tjald í röð tjaldanna. Teiknarinn myndar ferlana úr nákvæmlega þessum tölum, svo próf sem fylgir brotatoppi í ``geometry`` fylgir toppnum sem sést á skjánum. ``brightness`` er ferðandi birtubylgjan. Óreglulegar geislastöður með föstu slembifræi og sjálfstæðar samfelldar lengdar- og birtusveiflur móta sýnatökuflötinn, með mjókkandi toppum. Mynda bönd norðurljósanna og hreyfingu þeirra úr slembigjafanum.

records.context: At full Detail dots are drawn directly and stay crisp. Lower Detail samples the same canvas population through a bounded image buffer. Everything is batched into one ``drawPoints`` call per (colour, layer, alpha step) bucket with a cached pen; the per-call overhead of a pen change dominates this theme, not the pixels.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.DriftEngine#1
records.source: At full Detail dots are drawn directly and stay crisp. Lower Detail samples the same canvas population through a bounded image buffer. Everything is batched into one ``drawPoints`` call per (colour, layer, alpha step) bucket with a cached pen; the per-call overhead of a pen change dominates this theme, not the pixels.
records.translation: Við fullt Detail eru punktar teiknaðir beint og haldast skarpir. Lægra Detail samplar sama fjölda eininga á teiknifletinum í gegnum myndbiðminni með stærðarmörkum. Allt er sameinað í eitt ``drawPoints`` kall fyrir hvern flokk (litur, lag, alfaþrep) með penna úr skyndiminni; kostnaður við pennaskipti í hverju kalli er stærsti kostnaður þessa þema, ekki pixlarnir.

records.context: Outside `spaceout`, `glow` and `beat` retain the blue rim; `rainbow` walks the hue along the run and turns it over time, so the light carries a spectrum that moves rather than a band that sits still.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card.SetupCard.ink_at#1
records.source: Outside `spaceout`, `glow` and `beat` retain the blue rim; `rainbow` walks the hue along the run and turns it over time, so the light carries a spectrum that moves rather than a band that sits still.
records.translation: Utan `spaceout` halda `glow` og `beat` bláa jaðarljósinu; `rainbow` færir litblæinn eftir ljósalengjunni og breytir honum með tíma, svo ljósið myndar hreyfanlegt litróf frekar en kyrrstætt band.

records.context: UNDER ``spaceout`` the rim oscillates in every mode. The mark that follows the pointer is the one thing on a card that is already moving, and leaving it a fixed blue under a theme whose whole point is a moving spectrum is what the request is about. Its hue is the palette's own drift plus a much faster cycle of its own (:data:`SPACEOUT_RIM_PERIOD`), so it belongs to the same spectrum the rest of the window is travelling through instead of being a second unrelated rainbow.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card.SetupCard.ink_at#2
records.source: UNDER ``spaceout`` THE RIM OSCILLATES IN EVERY MODE. The mark that follows the pointer is the one thing on a card that is already moving, and leaving it a fixed blue under a theme whose whole point is a moving spectrum is what the request is about. Its hue is the palette's own drift plus a much faster cycle of its own (:data:`SPACEOUT_RIM_PERIOD`), so it belongs to the same spectrum the rest of the window is travelling through instead of being a second unrelated rainbow.
records.translation: Í ``spaceout`` SVEIFLAST JAÐARLJÓSIÐ Í ÖLLUM HÖMUM. Merkið sem fylgir bendlinum er það eina á kortinu sem þegar hreyfist, og beiðnin snýst um að halda því ekki föstu bláu undir þema sem byggist á hreyfanlegu litrófi. Litblær þess er hliðrun litaspjaldsins ásamt miklu hraðari eigin sveiflu (:data:`SPACEOUT_RIM_PERIOD`), svo það tilheyrir sama litrófi og restin af glugganum færist um, í stað þess að vera annar ótengdur regnbogi.
